intro: Each entry includes a video reference from YouTube for visual learners — tap or click the link to watch a demonstration of proper form.
band_note: A note on the band: choose a light or medium resistance loop or handle band. If a move feels too easy, shorten the band or use a heavier resistance; if it strains a joint, lengthen the band or lower the resistance.

exercises.name: Seated Mountain Pose
exercises.cues: Sit tall, feet flat, crown lifted, palms on thighs.

exercises.name: Seated Cat-Cow
exercises.cues: Arch and round the spine with the breath.

exercises.name: Seated Side Stretch
exercises.cues: Reach one arm overhead, lean gently to the side.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
exercises.cues: Hand on opposite knee, rotate from the ribcage.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.cues: Hinge from hips over the thighs, let head hang.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rolls
exercises.cues: Slow half-circles, chin to chest and ear to shoulder.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls
exercises.cues: Roll shoulders up, back, and down.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Opener
exercises.cues: Clasp hands behind back, lift chest.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Circles
exercises.cues: Lift one foot, circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Seated Marching
exercises.cues: Lift knees alternately toward chest.

exercises.name: Seated Figure-4 Stretch
exercises.cues: Cross ankle over opposite knee, lean forward slightly.

exercises.name: Seated Knee-to-Chest Hug
exercises.cues: Draw one knee up and hug it in.

exercises.name: Seated Cow-Face Arms
exercises.cues: Reach one arm overhead and back, one from below.

exercises.name: Seated Eagle Arms
exercises.cues: Cross arms, press forearms together, lift elbows.

exercises.name: Seated Sun Salutation Flow
exercises.cues: Arms sweep up on inhale, fold forward on exhale.

exercises.name: Seated Pigeon Stretch
exercises.cues: Ankle on opposite knee, sit tall, fold slightly.

exercises.name: Seated Crossbody Arm Stretch
exercises.cues: Pull one arm across chest with opposite hand.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Reach
exercises.cues: Interlace fingers, press palms to ceiling.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist & Finger Stretch
exercises.cues: Extend arm, gently pull fingers back then down.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
exercises.cues: Press through balls of feet, lift heels.

exercises.name: Seated Toe Taps
exercises.cues: Heels down, tap toes rapidly.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Extensions
exercises.cues: Straighten one knee to hip height, lower with control.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Circles
exercises.cues: Circle the upper body slowly from the hips.

exercises.name: Seated Chair Plank Hold
exercises.cues: Hands on seat, lift hips slightly, brace core.

exercises.name: Seated Elbow-to-Knee Twist
exercises.cues: Bring opposite elbow toward lifting knee.

exercises.name: Guided Seated Meditation
exercises.cues: Eyes closed, follow the breath, soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: Deep Belly Breathing
exercises.cues: Hand on belly, inhale through nose 4 counts, exhale 6.

exercises.name: Seated Gentle Sway
exercises.cues: Rock weight gently side to side, hips loose.

exercises.name: Band Seated Row
exercises.cues: Band around feet, pull handles to ribs, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Band Chest Press
exercises.cues: Band behind chair back, press handles forward.

exercises.name: Band Overhead Press
exercises.cues: Band under feet, press handles overhead.

exercises.name: Band Bicep Curl
exercises.cues: Stand or sit on band, curl handles to shoulders.

exercises.name: Band Tricep Extension
exercises.cues: Band overhead, extend forearm down and back.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Raise
exercises.cues: Band under feet, raise arms out to sides to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Band Front Raise
exercises.cues: Band under feet, raise arms forward to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Pull-Apart
exercises.cues: Hold band taut at chest height, pull ends apart.

exercises.name: Band Seated Leg Press
exercises.cues: Band around one foot, press leg forward and out.

exercises.name: Band Seated Leg Abduction
exercises.cues: Band around both thighs, press knees outward.

exercises.name: Band Standing Squat
exercises.cues: Band under feet, handles at shoulders, sit back and stand.

exercises.name: Band Ankle Dorsiflexion
exercises.cues: Band around foot, flex toes toward shin against resistance.

exercises.name: Band Wood Chop
exercises.cues: Anchor band low, pull diagonally across body to opposite shoulder.

exercises.name: Band Standing Hip Extension
exercises.cues: Band around ankle, kick leg straight back holding chair.

exercises.name: Band Assisted Overhead Stretch
exercises.cues: Hold band overhead wider than shoulders, gentle pull side to side.

exercises.name: Band Seated Torso Rotation
exercises.cues: Anchor band to side, rotate torso away holding handle.

exercises.name: Band Bent-Over Reverse Fly
exercises.cues: Hinge forward slightly, pull handles out and back.

exercises.name: Band Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cues: Band under feet, hold chair, rise onto toes.

exercises.name: A note on the band
exercises.cues: choose a light or medium resistance loop or handle band. If a move feels too easy, shorten the band or use a heavier resistance; if it strains a joint, lengthen the band or lower the resistance.

exercises.name: A note on the videos
exercises.cues: these are third-party YouTube demonstrations selected for clear, safe form cues, not official medical guidance. Always prioritize your own body's feedback and your doctor's or physical therapist's direction over any video.
